verdict.rationale: The product keeps no hosted data. Its documented install path writes skills into your repo as ordinary editable files under an MIT license, works with any agent, and supports local markdown as the issue tracker, so your artifacts already sit in open formats you own. A runtime probe confirmed SKILL.md files land in ./.claude/skills/. However, nothing documents an explicit export or uninstall/offboarding path, and the plugin route is a managed read-only bundle rather than files you own. Missing for 10: documented export/offboarding procedure, clarity on leaving when installed via the managed plugin, independent corroboration of portability.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can export all of my data in open formats and leave
